name: Ron Sahu
office: City of Alhambra, Member of the City Council, First District

items.text: Ron Sahu is an environmental engineer with a PhD from Caltech. He has served on the city's Planning, Environmental Sustainability, and Parks and Recreation commissions. He says he has led the advocacy group Grassroots Alhambra for two decades. He identified traffic congestion and development scale as common concerns, along with balancing housing needs.

sentences.text: Ron Sahu is an environmental engineer with a PhD from Caltech.
He has served on the city's Planning, Environmental Sustainability, and Parks and Recreation commissions.
He says he has led the advocacy group Grassroots Alhambra for two decades.
He identified traffic congestion and development scale as common concerns, along with balancing housing needs.

items.text: His campaign says he supports greater government transparency and long-term public investments, as well as development that considers traffic and infrastructure. At a February 2026 council meeting, he criticized the spending of $2 million on Measure R projects with no progress. At a May 2026 town hall where he spoke, the council agreed to conduct a traffic study for the 710 Stub.
